    LargeIndecomposable.exists_embeddingData_bounded_of

    The reduction of Lemma 3.1 with the nilpotence bound #

    The nilpotence bound n of the data of Theorem 5.2 is unchanged by transport along inflation and the Morita functor, and the minimal quotient B of the basic corner has dim B ≤ dim A. So a bound n + 1 ≤ max(30, 4 dim B) for the split basic minimal distributive algebras (DistributiveEmbeddingDataBounded) gives the same bound for every representation-infinite A (exists_embeddingData_bounded_of); the nondistributive case has n ≤ dim B (SplitBasicData.exists_embeddingData_le).
